mismatchTracker.title: Mismatch Tracker
mismatchTracker.subtitle: Track, dispute and resolve payment differences with your providers
mismatchTracker.howItWorks1: Weekly report — A consolidated report per provider with all discrepancies (new + pending)
mismatchTracker.howItWorks2: Three sections — New discrepancies, still pending from previous reports, and recently resolved
mismatchTracker.howItWorks3: Urgent override — For large amounts or missing payments, switch to 'Urgent' and send immediately
mismatchTracker.howItWorks4: Auto-check — After each bank upload, the system looks for automatic resolutions
mismatchTracker.howItWorks5: Tracks times reported — The provider cannot claim they never received it

communications.title: Dispute Communications
communications.subtitle: Track every email sent to your payment providers. See what was disputed, when it was sent, and if it was delivered
communications.noCommunicationsDesc: Emails sent from the Mismatch Tracker will appear here automatically

setup.title: Setup
setup.subtitle: Manage your client portfolio, stores, providers, bank accounts and data privacy
setup.addFirstClient: Add your first client to build your portfolio
setup.disputeEmailDesc: Configure the dispute contact email for each provider. These emails are used when you click 'Send Email' from the Mismatch Tracker
setup.dataResidencyDesc: All data stored exclusively in European data centres (Frankfurt / Paris)
setup.encryptionDesc: Encrypted at rest. TLS 1.3 in transit. Your bank statements are unreadable to us without your session
setup.zeroSharingDesc: We do not share your data with tax authorities, advertisers, AI trainers or third parties. Never
setup.gdprDesc: Right of access, right to erasure, right to portability. Request your data at any time
setup.autoPurgeDesc: Automatically delete transaction data older than the selected period
setup.dangerZoneDesc: Deleting your data is irreversible. Your bank statements, provider transactions and store configuration will be permanently removed
